scripts.text:
[Dewata Guide]
Welcome to ^8B4513Dewata Island^000000,
a place with dazzling waves and charming views it's a great place to relax.
If you have any questions, please ask me.
scripts.translation:
[德瓦他向导]
欢迎来到^8B4513德瓦他岛^000000。
这里波光粼粼，风景迷人，是放松身心的好地方。
有任何问题，请随时问我。

scripts.text:
[Dewata Guide]
Where can I guide you?
scripts.translation:
[德瓦他向导]
您想去哪里？

scripts.text:
[Dewata Guide]
When you click on the ^B9062F[location name]^000000, you'll receive the most advanced ^B9062FNavigation^000000 services!
scripts.translation:
[德瓦他向导]
点击^B9062F[地点名称]^000000，便可享受最先进的^B9062F导航^000000服务！
